nodes.label: Writing For Agents Skill
nodes.rationale: Design patterns and best practices for creating AI agent skills, tools, and workflows.

nodes.label: GitHub PRD Generation Skill
nodes.rationale: Automates structured PRD writing with user stories and architectural specs.

nodes.label: Better Auth & SQLite Adapter
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted auth library with built-in RBAC and Drizzle adapter support.

nodes.label: Storeight Architecture Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Establishes server-first patterns, zero floating-point money rules, and ACID transaction rules.

nodes.label: SQLite & Drizzle ORM
nodes.rationale: Embedded relational database with compile-time typesafety and fast local development.

nodes.label: Storeight Architecture
nodes.rationale: Modular ecommerce platform with strict domain boundaries and ACID transaction guarantees.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS & shadcn/ui
nodes.rationale: Accessible, token-driven component architecture with responsive layouts.

nodes.label: TanStack Query & Table
nodes.rationale: Optimistic UI synchronization and high-performance tabular data grids.

nodes.label: Zod Schema Validation
nodes.rationale: End-to-end runtime type validation across forms, actions, and API boundaries.

nodes.label: Core Infrastructure Domain
nodes.rationale: Provides database connections, transactional units of work, and domain event bus.

nodes.label: Experience Domain
nodes.rationale: Handles customer storefront, product UI, customer accounts, and admin management UI.

nodes.label: Integration Domain
nodes.rationale: Bridges external payment gateways, courier shipping providers, and marketplace sync.

nodes.label: Intelligence Domain
nodes.rationale: Aggregates sales metrics, inventory velocity, GMV, and conversion funnel analytics.

nodes.label: Operation Domain
nodes.rationale: Manages back-office catalog, variant matrices, 3-tier inventory, and warehouse fulfillment.

nodes.label: Transaction Domain
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates cart manager, checkout flow, shipping rates, payments, and immutable orders.

nodes.label: Cart State Model
nodes.rationale: Tracks customer session items, line-item pricing snapshots, and currency.

nodes.label: Checkout Orchestrator & Saga
nodes.rationale: Manages transactional saga: reserves stock, calculates shipping, creates transaction, confirms order, commits stock.

nodes.label: Domain Event Bus
nodes.rationale: In-process or queue-based decoupled pub/sub for domain state changes.

nodes.label: Order Fulfillment Workflow
nodes.rationale: Picks, packs, requests courier waybill, and dispatches tracking numbers.

nodes.label: Order Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Orders transition Pending -> Confirmed -> Processing -> Shipped -> Delivered / Cancelled.

nodes.label: Payment Transaction Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: State machine: Initiated -> Authorized -> Captured / Failed / Refunded.

nodes.label: Product & Variant Model
nodes.rationale: SKU, stock, pricing, and physical dimensions reside strictly at variant child level.

nodes.label: Inventory TTL Reaper Worker
nodes.rationale: Periodic background worker releasing expired stock reservations to prevent inventory deadlocks.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Inventory Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Finite stock moves from Available -> Reserved (with TTL) -> Committed on payment success.

nodes.label: Next.js App Router & React 19
nodes.rationale: Full-stack React framework utilizing Server Components and Server Actions for transactional security.

nodes.label: P0 Critical Transaction Foundation
nodes.rationale: Catalog, variant architecture, 3-tier inventory, cart, and checkout.

nodes.label: P1 Operational Core
nodes.rationale: Order management, admin catalog UI, inventory adjustments, and auth RBAC.

nodes.label: P0-P3 Priority Framework
nodes.rationale: Strict governance prioritizing transaction core (P0) over operational tooling (P1), adapters (P2), and scaling (P3).

nodes.label: 5-Phase Implementation Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 Setup -> Phase 1 Domain Entities -> Phase 2 Transaction Core -> Phase 3 UI & Workflows -> Phase 4 Ops & Intelligence.
